seo.h1: Directory of Al-Ahsa online stores selling local products
seo.meta_description: Discover online stores selling authentic Al-Ahsa products, from dates and handicrafts to coffee and Hasawi (Al-Ahsa) rice, in one directory that takes you straight to each store.

lead: {n} online stores from Al-Ahsa in one place: dates, handicrafts and local products. Each link takes you straight to the store.

ui.search: Search by store name or product…
ui.directOrder: Order directly from the craftsperson through the account.
ui.disclaimer: This directory is for information only. Sales, payment, shipping and returns are each store's responsibility. Check the store's policy before buying.

stores.name: Al-Sheraa Dates
stores.description: Sells Khalas and Razeez dates, pollen water and Shaabiyyat.

stores.name: Hajar Orchards Dates Factory
stores.description: A factory selling Khalas dates in several grades, Shishi dates, and dates stuffed with cashews, almonds and pistachios, along with date molasses and date tahini. It has Instagram and Snapchat accounts.

stores.name: Al-Sharq Dates
stores.description: A date factory operating since 2011, selling dates and date products. Its most distinctive product is date sugar.

stores.name: Safsif Store
stores.description: A family brand built around Hasawi Razeez dates, stuffed Khalas dates, maamoul (date-filled pastry) and date sweets, along with Hasawi rice, coffee and Hasawi sweets. It has accounts on X, Instagram and Snapchat.

stores.name: Al-Ameen Dates Factory
stores.description: A factory founded in 1995, selling pressed dates, molasses, date maamoul and date sweets, porridge mixes, Hasawi date cake and Hasawi lumi (dried lime). Some items were out of stock at the time of checking.

stores.name: Al-Abdullatif Dates Factory
stores.description: A factory selling premium dates and offering date packing and buying services. It has WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok and Snapchat channels.

stores.name: Ibn Zaid Store
stores.description: Sells Halibi dates, Ibn Zaid's two Hasawi lines "Qulla" and "Shanna", molasses and ghee, and ships inside and outside Saudi Arabia.

stores.name: Wqleh
stores.description: A dates and coffee store selling handmade Khalas, Shishi, almond-stuffed Khalas, molasses and date paste, along with date serving dishes.

stores.name: Ali Hattab Dates
stores.description: Sells Khalas and Saqai dates, molasses and maamoul, along with sesame tahini, ghee and lumi (dried lime). It has a TikTok account.

stores.name: Aqeel Al-Habib Farms
stores.description: Sells handmade and factory-made Khalas and Shishi dates, date halqoum (a chewy sweet), maamoul and molasses, along with honey and lemon products.

stores.name: Al-Jawhariya Dates
stores.description: A factory that states it was founded in 1993, selling top-grade Al-Ahsa Khalas dates, stuffed dates, molasses, tahini and gift boxes.

stores.name: Arish Al-Ahsa Premium Dates
stores.description: Selects Al-Ahsa dates: premium Khalas, Shishi and handmade Razeez, along with handmade molasses, tahini and Hasawi sesame. It has Instagram, X, TikTok and Snapchat accounts.

stores.name: Al-Tayyar Premium Dates Factory
stores.description: Operating since 2016, it sells Khalas, Sukkari, Shishi, Saqai and Ajwa dates, date boxes, heritage gifts and maamoul.

stores.name: Al-Rafayea
stores.description: An agricultural company selling pitted and stuffed dates, date molasses and date paste, and offering packing and fumigation services. It has WhatsApp and Instagram channels.

stores.name: Al-Yasmeen Organic Farm
stores.description: A store for local organic products, led by its organic dates section. Its focus is mainly dates, though not exclusively.

stores.name: Qaitan (Ahmed Abdullah Al-Qattan Mashalih)
stores.description: Sells hand-stitched bishts and mashalih (traditional cloaks) in seasonal collections, plus women's bishts, and presents its output as a handed-down craft. It has WhatsApp, Instagram and TikTok channels.

stores.name: Al-Qattan Royal Mashalih
stores.description: Specialises in handmade Hasawi bishts with several types of zari (metallic thread) and luxury gift boxes.

stores.name: Ahmed Mohammed Al-Qattan Mashalih
stores.description: Tailors royal mashalih of various kinds and delivers to regions of Saudi Arabia and the Gulf states. Its latest post was about eight months ago.

stores.name: Mohammed Al-Ameer Royal Mashalih
stores.description: Handmade bishts of natural camel hair and wool with silver and gold zari. The account is active daily and delivers across Saudi Arabia and the Gulf states.

stores.name: Iqal Al-Sultan

stores.name: Al-Mayameen Prayer Beads
stores.description: A prayer-bead shop that sells and repairs, with beads in bakelite, amber and teak wood and a section for items it makes locally.

stores.name: LANT
stores.description: A small brand offering woodwork and hand-designed products with a modern touch. The product details were not read in full.

stores.name: Al-Hawan Store

stores.name: Zaki Al-Salem Natural Al-Ahsa Products

stores.description: A roastery and spice shop selling Arabic coffee, spices, herbs, oils, nuts and saffron, and shipping to all cities in Saudi Arabia.

stores.name: Lomi Hasawi
stores.description: A brand that turns Hasawi lumi (dried lime) into creative products: chilli sauce, maaboj, ground lumi, spice blends and gift boxes.

stores.name: Alma Specialty Coffee Store

stores.name: Bon Roastery
stores.description: A specialty coffee roastery that imports selected beans and roasts them locally, and also sells insulated cups and whole-oat granola with no added sugar. It has a cafe in Hofuf and an active Instagram account with more than 27,000 followers.

stores.name: Ghusn Al-Zuhoor
stores.description: Fresh and artificial flowers, flower arrangements, chocolate, balloons and gifts, with monthly subscriptions and same-day delivery.

stores.name: Al-Ahsa Gifts
stores.description: Sells and arranges flowers, wraps gifts and delivers them the same day, with supplies for welcoming newborns and heat printing.

stores.name: Al-Ahsa Roses (Flower Hasa)
stores.description: Wholesale fresh flowers and bouquet arranging, with delivery inside Al-Ahsa, a mobile app, and Instagram and Snapchat accounts.

stores.name: Mohammed Al-Qattan Shops

stores.name: Al-Tajira Ghufran

stores.name: Saaf

stores.name: Al-Salateen

stores.name: Khurz wa Farz Prayer Beads

stores.name: Kiral

stores.name: Al-Farawla
stores.description: Cosmetics and skincare from several brands.

faq.q: What are the best-known Al-Ahsa Governorate products you can buy online?
faq.a: The best-known Al-Ahsa Governorate products sold online include premium dates such as Khalas and Shishi, and red Hasawi rice, which is rich in minerals. Handicrafts such as the Hasawi bisht (traditional cloak) and the iqal (headdress cord) also stand out, along with processed Hasawi lumi (dried lime) products. Verified online stores offer these heritage goods to customers in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf states with high quality and guaranteed authenticity.

faq.q: Where can I buy authentic Al-Ahsa dates online?
faq.a: Authentic Al-Ahsa dates can be bought from the online stores of verified local factories and farms. The Visit Al-Ahsa directory links to approved platforms offering Khalas and Razeez varieties, which are subject to quality and packing standards, ensuring the harvest reaches shoppers in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf states fresh.

faq.q: How do I check that a Hasawi bisht is authentic when buying online?
faq.a: To check the authenticity of a Hasawi bisht when buying online, make sure the store is approved and based in the Al-Ahsa oasis. A genuine bisht is hand-woven with silver or gold zari thread and is regarded as a heritage registered with UNESCO. Specialised, verified stores provide guarantees confirming the precision of the embroidery and the quality of the fabric used.

faq.q: What makes Hasawi rice special, and how is it cooked?
faq.a: Hasawi rice is known for its red grain and high nutritional value. It is grown in the Al-Ahsa oasis under high temperatures that give it its distinctive qualities. It needs plenty of water and longer than ordinary rice to cook through fully. Al-Ahsa online stores supply it carefully packaged to preserve its quality.

faq.q: Do Al-Ahsa online stores ship to the Gulf states?
faq.a: Yes, many online stores in Al-Ahsa Governorate offer fast, reliable shipping to all the Arab Gulf states. These stores benefit from the Gulf economic agreement that eases trade in national products. It is advisable to check each store's own shipping policy for the exact time and cost.

faq.q: When is the Al-Ahsa date harvest, so I can buy the new crop?
faq.a: The date harvest season in the Al-Ahsa oasis begins in late August with the Ghar and Shishi varieties, and peaks in September and October with the picking of Khalas and Razeez. Buying online during these months lets shoppers get the new, fresh crop directly from the region's approved farms and factories.

faq.q: How is Hasawi lumi (dried lime) used, and how is it sold online?
faq.a: Hasawi lumi is used as a staple heritage ingredient that adds a distinctive sour flavour to Saudi and Gulf cooking. The limes are sun-dried with great care, and Al-Ahsa online stores sell them as whole pieces or as ground spice. It is usually added to rice and meat dishes to give them a unique depth of flavour and an authentic taste.

faq.q: What is the best way to store Al-Ahsa dates after they arrive?
faq.a: To keep the quality of Al-Ahsa dates bought online, store them in airtight containers away from moisture and high heat. It is advisable to keep dates in the fridge if you will eat them soon, or in the freezer for longer periods of up to several months, which keeps the taste and texture of the dates intact and protects them from quick spoilage.

faq.q: Where are Al-Ahsa handicrafts such as the iqal sold online?
faq.a: Heritage handicrafts such as the Hasawi iqal made from wool or goat hair are sold through specialised online stores operating exclusively from Al-Ahsa Governorate. The Visit Al-Ahsa directory brings together the leading trusted platforms that support local craftspeople, letting shoppers easily acquire authentic artistic pieces.

faq.q: Can I buy Al-Ahsa dates in bulk for gifts and occasions?
faq.a: Yes, many online stores and factories in Al-Ahsa Governorate allow dates and Hasawi rice to be bought in wholesale quantities suited to gifts and occasions. Products are packed to the strict standards of the National Center for Palms and Dates, and dedicated shipping options are available so that large quantities reach buyers safely.
